Name: UserDefinedDownload
DowloadScript
Content:
<![CDATA[
function request$Download(g, a) {
  g.request(g, 'Download', a, []);
  var r = $get('requestFormData');
  if (!r) r = $func.requestFormData();
  var query = '?a=1&t=' + ']]>&TransferID;<![CDATA[' + '&k=' + g._key;
  r.action = $func.resolveClientUrl('~/AppHandler/Transfer.ashx' + query, g._baseUrl);
  if (!$func.isIE) r.target = '_blank';
  r.submit();
  if (g._activeCell) g._activeCell.focus();
}
]]>

Name: UnitBeforeUpdate
Content:
if @@admin = 0 begin
  if $dmtkdv.NewValue <> $dmtkdv.OldValue begin
    if exists(select 1 from dmtkdv a where tk = $tk.OldValue and not exists(select 1 from @dmtkdv b where b.ma_dvcs = a.ma_dvcs) and not exists(select 1 from sysunitrights c where c.ma_dvcs = a.ma_dvcs and c.user_id = @@userID and c.r_access = 1)) begin
      select 'dmtkdv' as field, case when @@language = 'v' then N'Tồn tại đơn vị trong các đơn vị bị xóa không hợp lệ, không thể lưu được.' else N'Some unit codes might not be removed or you are not authorized to execute this function.' end as message
      return
    end
    if exists(select 1 from @dmtkdv a where not exists(select 1 from @dmtkdv b where b.tk = $tk.OldValue and b.ma_dvcs = a.ma_dvcs) and not exists(select 1 from sysunitrights c where c.ma_dvcs = a.ma_dvcs and c.user_id = @@userID and c.r_access = 1)) begin
      select 'dmtkdv' as field, case when @@language = 'v' then N'Tồn tại đơn vị trong các đơn vị vừa cập nhật không hợp lệ, không thể lưu được.' else N'Some unit codes are invalid or you are not authorized to execute this function.' end as message
      return
    end
  end
end

if @tk <> $tk.OldValue begin
  if $dmtkdv.NewValue = $dmtkdv.OldValue
    update dmtkdv set tk = @tk where tk = $tk.OldValue
end

update @dmtkdv set tk = @tk
if $dmtkdv.NewValue <> $dmtkdv.OldValue
  delete dmtkdv where tk = $tk.OldValue

  return
end
